chapter.verse: Paul in Derbe khua leh Listra khua-ah a tung hi. Tua Listra khua-ah Timoti min nei nungzui khat a om hi. A nu in thu-um Judah numei ahi hi.
A pa ahih leh, Grik mi ahi hi. Tua pa in Listra khua leh Ikonium khua-ah a om ute naute kiangah maipha a ngah mi ahi hi.
Paul in amah a tonpih nuam hi. A pa Grik mi ahih lam tua gamah a om Judah mite in a theih manunah ama vun a atsak hi.
Amaute in khuapite-ah a pai lai takun Jerusalem khua-ah a om sawltakte leh upate in thukhensatnate a man’ nadingun pawlpite a pia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pawlpite’ upna a kip semsem a, ni simin mimal a khang semsem uh hi.
Frigia gam leh Galati gamah a paisuak khit uh ciangun Asia gamah Pasian thu hilh lo dingin Kha Siangtho in a kham hi.
Misia gamah a tun’ uh ciangin Bithinia gamah pai ding thu a ngaihsut lai takun Zeisu’ Kha in thu a pia kei hi.
Misia gam nawlah pai-in Troas khua-ah a tung uh hi.
Zan ciangin Paul in mang a mu hi. Tua mang sungah Makedonia mi khat ding-in, “Makedonia gamah galkah in la, kote hong huh in,” ci-in a thuum hi.

Paul in mang a muh khit ciangin Makedonia gamah pai-in, amaute kiangah Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin Pasian in kote hong sawl zo hi ci-in ka ciamteh ka ngaihsun uh ahih ciangin, tua gamah thakhatin pai na’ng ka hanciam uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Troas khua panin teembaw tungah tuangin Somathroasia kici tuikulh gamah tang takin ka pai uh hi. A zingsang ciangin Neapolis khua-ah ka tung uh hi.
Tua khua panin paikhia-in Rom khua kici Makedonia gam sungah a lianbel khua ahi, Filippi khua ka tung uh a, sawt veipi ka tam uh hi.
Nipi ni-in komau in khua nawlah paikhia-in, thungetna mun om ngei-a ka upna uh gun gei-ah pai-in, ka tut khit uh ciangin tua san takah a kikhawm numeite thu ka hilh uh hi.
Puansan a zuak Thiatira khua mi ahi, Pasian a bia numei a min Lidia in komau thu a za hi. Tua numei in Paul’ thuhilhna a san’ theih nadingin Pasian in ama lungsim a hon’sak hi.
Amah in a innkuanpihte tawh a kibaptaiz khit ciangin, “Keimah in Topa sungah thu-um mi khat ka hihna nong up uh leh, keima innah hong tung un la, tam un,” ci-in thuumin, hong kho hi.
Tua nung ciangin thungetna mun lam ka pai lai takun aisanin ama tote ading summeet ngah thei, dawi-lut sila nungak khat in kote hong dawn hi.
Tua nungak in Paul leh komau hong zui a, “Hih mite in gupna Lampi eite hong hilh, Sang Pen Pasian’ nasemte ahi uh hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Tua bangin ni tampi a hih hi. Paul in lungdam lo a, kihei-in, “Zeisu Khazih’ min tawh ama sung pan na paikhia in, thu kong pia hi,” a cih ciangin tua dawi in thakhatin a taikhia hi.
Ama tote in summeet ngah na’ng lametna om lo hi cih a theih ciangun, Paul leh Silas man uh a, khua ukte mai-a sumbuk lamah a paipih uh hi.
Thukhen mangte kiangah a tun’ uh ciangin, “Hih mite in Judah mi hi napi-in kote khua hong bawlsia uh a,
Rom mi ahi eite in i san’ ding leh i zuih dinga kilawm lo ngeina thute hong hilh uh hi,” ci-in a ko uh hi.
Mihonpite in amau langkhatah a ding uh a, thukhen mangte in amau puan balkek uh a, ciangpum tawh sat nadingin thu a pia uh hi.
A tampi a liam khit uh ciangin, “Pha takpi na cing in,” ci-in thong ukpa vaikhakin thong sungah a khum uh hi.
Thong ukpa in tua banga vaikhakna thu a ngah khit ciangin thong tawngnung sungah khumin, amau khe ah kol a bulh hi.
Zan kim lai takin Paul leh Silas in thungenin Pasian’ min phatna la a sa uh a, thongkia mite in a ngaih lai takun,
thakhatin zin nakpi liing a, thong innbul zong liing a, kongkhak khempeuh kihong a, mi khempeuh kisutkhia uh hi.
Thong ukpa tho a, kongkhakte hon’sa-a om a muh ciangin, thongkiate khempeuh suakta khin hi ci-in a up ciangin a namsau a paai pan dok a, amahmah kithat dingin a kisa hi.
Ahih hangin Paul in, “Nang tungah bangmah na hih kei in, kote khempeuh ka om uh hi,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
Thong ukpa in meivak a nget khit ciangin lut pahin, Paul leh Silas’ khe mai-ah bokin, launa tawh a liing hi.
Amah in amaute inn pua-ah a paipih khit ciangin, “Tote aw, gupna ngah nadingin bang ka hih ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Topa Zeisu na up leh, nangmah tawh, na innkuanpihte tawh gupna na ngah ding uh hi,” ci-in,
amah akipan a innkuanpihte Topa’ thu a hilh uh hi.
Tua nai lai takin thong ukpa in Paul leh Silas la a, a kisatna ma a sawpsak khit ciangin, amah leh a innkuanpihte tawh thakhatin a kibaptaiz uh hi.
Ama innah lutpih a, an vaak a, Pasian a up manin, a innkuanpihte khempeuh tawh a lungdam uh hi.
A zingsang ciangin thukhen mangte in palik bute pai sakin, “Tua mite na khah un,” ci-in a vaikhak uh hi.
Thong ukpa in, “Na kikhah nading uh thu thukhen mangte in hong paisak zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na paikhia un la, nuam takin na pai un,” ci-in tua thute Paul kiangah a gen hi.

Ahih hangin Paul in, “Rom mi ahi kote thukhen loin a kilangin a hong sat khit uh ciangin, thong sungah a hong khum zo uh hi. Tu-in hong khahkhia sim ding ahi uh hiam? Hi lo hi! Amaute hong pai hen la, a kilangin komau hong lakhia uh hen,” ci-in palik bute kiangah a gen hi.
Palik bute in hih thu, thukhen mangte kiangah a koh uh ciangin, Paul leh Silas in Rom ahih lam a zak uh ciangin a lau mahmah uh a,
amaute mah hong pai uh a, thuumin a lakkhiat khit uh ciangin khua sung pan a paikhiat nading a ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul leh Silas in thong sung pan paikhia-in, Lidia’ innah a lut uh a, ute naute tawh kimu-in, amaute a lungkipsak khit uh ciangin a paikhia uh hi.
